description: Metadata for the confirmed public Google DeepMind publications index and individual publication pages on deepmind.google. Each URL was confirmed with one bounded GET. Rows store a title, publisher, canonical URL, date, and rights label. Abstracts, page bodies, and PDFs are not stored. Rights is creative_commons only when that page states CC0, CC BY, or CC BY-SA; CC BY-NC, CC BY-ND, CC BY-NC-SA, and CC BY-NC-ND stay unknown. A missing publication date stays unknown. This catalog is not a belief collector.
